intro.text:
Hi, I'm Yumi Zhao.

I am a senior studying Bioengineering with a minor in EECS at UC Berkeley.

My work is rooted in hands-on hardware engineering and physical system integration. I specialize in building and testing tangible prototypes—ranging from designing mechanical mechanisms and integrating custom circuits for bio-inspired robots to enable targeted motion, to developing micro-controller firmware and real-time data acquisition platforms. I enjoy bridging the gap between mechanical hardware, electronics, and software.

Welcome to my portfolio—feel free to explore my projects below.
